name: Hitozuma Deriheru Jou Akiko
original_name: 人妻デリヘル嬢 章子
source:
When a chaste married woman's carnal desire is awakened, she cannot resist the abyss.

"My husband doesn't know! Please! Ask for someone else!"


Saitou missed the last train out of Tokyo to his suburban home
and stayed at a business hotel for the night. That's where he found the flyer.
It was for an escort service. Why not? But when the girl arrived, Saitou was shocked.
In the doorway stood his neighbor's wife, Akiko Miyata.
She teasingly asked that he change her for a different girl, but Saitou refused.
She panicked. Please. Change. But the only thing that was going to chance
was the relationship between Akiko, Saitou and her cuckold of a husband.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE112234.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
当一名贞洁已婚女人的肉欲被唤醒后，她便无法抗拒深渊。

“我丈夫不知道！求你了！去找别人吧！”

斋藤错过了从东京开往郊区住处的末班车，只好在商务酒店过夜。就在酒店里，他发现了一张传单。

那是一家陪侍服务。试试看又何妨？然而女孩到来后，斋藤大吃一惊。

门口站着他的邻居、宫田明子的妻子。

她故意逗弄斋藤，请他把自己换成另一个女孩，但斋藤拒绝了。她惊慌失措，不停地请求他更换对象。

然而，真正即将改变的，是明子、斋藤和她那位戴绿帽的丈夫之间的关系。

[来自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE112234.html]DLsite English[/url]]
